title: Environment Duels: A Microcosm of LLM Co-Evolution
abstract: arXiv:2610.30116v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Through a tangle of real-world interactions, from synthetic training pipelines to data shared on the open web, frontier LLMs absorb what their predecessors and competitors create. How well does each model play its role in this ecosystem, as a creator and as a solver? We introduce Environment Duels, a dynamic agentic benchmark that evaluates both capabilities on interactive environments. Each model writes environments, each with a privileged hint, aiming for tasks that capable solvers fail without the hint and pass with it. Across nine frontier LLMs, solving and authoring prove to be distinct skills: the strongest solvers are not the strongest authors, while smaller models learn more from how others played and write the hardest environments and the most useful hints. translated_title: 环境对决：大语言模型协同进化的缩影
translated_abstract: 通过从合成训练管线到开放网络共享数据等纷繁的真实世界互动，前沿大语言模型会吸收其前代模型与竞争者所创造的内容。那么在这一生态系统中，每个模型作为创造者和作为解决者分别扮演得如何？我们提出了 Environment Duels（环境对决），这是一个动态的智能体基准，用于在交互式环境中评估上述两种能力。每个模型负责编写环境，每个环境附带一条特权提示，其目标是设计出这样的任务：有能力的解决者在没有提示时失败，而在获得提示后通过。在九个前沿大语言模型上的实验表明，解决与创作是两种截然不同的技能：最强的解决者并非最强的创作者；而较小的模型更能从其他模型的解题方式中学习，并能写出最难的环境和最有用的提示。超越分数本身，模型之间的两两互动构成了模型间相互影响方式的缩影。一对一的对决结果具有传递性，因此能够得出一个稳定的排名……
tldr: 提出“环境对决”这一动态智能体基准，让大语言模型同时担任环境创作者与任务解决者两种角色，发现解决与创作是两种不同的能力，并利用模型间两两对决的传递性结果刻画了模型协同进化的稳定生态图景。
en_tdlr: Environment Duels is a dynamic agentic benchmark where LLMs act as both environment authors and solvers, revealing that solving and authoring are distinct skills, and that transitive pairwise duel outcomes yield a stable ranking capturing how models co-evolve.
